name: bronze
first_pickup_chronicle: Bronze. Older than iron. The Iliad was written for soldiers who carried this. It is not the strongest metal — it is the FIRST metal. That matters somehow.
design_notes: Peak F5 spread 7 — common early. damage_mult 0.85 (between copper 0.7 and iron 1.0). Slight weight penalty (1.05×). effective_against fey is a soft-mythological tie (bronze age vs the Tuatha). cite: curve.weapon_base_damage(5) ≈ 1-2, bronze longsword = ~1-2.
